tiktok.body:

This update sucks . // #foryou #kalogerassisters #kalogeras #fy #viral 🔍::  The new TikTok algorithm update has been incredibly frustrating for editors because it’s become much harder for high-quality edits to reach the audience they deserve. Many editors spend hours creating smooth transitions, syncing clips to music, and adding creative effects, only for their videos to receive a fraction of the views they used to. Instead of rewarding originality and effort, the algorithm often seems to favor random trends or already-popular creators, making it difficult for smaller editing accounts to grow. As a result, many talented editors feel discouraged, with some even considering quitting because their hard work is no longer being recognized the way it once was. //
